description.value:
Duration constant

A standing bonus to Fortitude, doubled against attacks on your Zeal.

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves. This bonus is doubled against effects that specifically target your Zeal, your Rites, or your spellcasting.

cinderfall.incomplete: "This bonus is doubled against effects that specifically target your Zeal, your Rites, or your spellcasting" is blocked twice over: Zeal has no rule-element existence anywhere in this class to be "targeted" in the first place (cultist.bargain.json's own system.rules is only ChoiceSet+GrantItem -- no SpecialResource), and no predicate exists in pf2e-source distinguishing a save's target-of-attack at that granularity ("this save is specifically against an effect targeting my Zeal/Rites/spellcasting").
